explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/1129: taking the x_i as the roots of the n-th Chebyshev polynomial gives Λ < (2/π) log n + O(1). The Lean statement: ∃ C, for all n ≥ 1 and x with IsChebyshevNodes x (a strictly increasing node set in [−1,1] of n points all of which are zeros of T_n, hence exactly the n zeros), lebesgueConstant x < (2/π)·log n + C. Faithful.
